title: The reset page won’t let me
picker_summary: Finance analyst wants self-service reset turned on, today.

caller.name: Ana
caller.mood: Stressed, it's month-end close. A bit annoyed she has to call at all.
caller.opening_line: Hi, I forgot my password and the reset page won’t let me do it myself. It just says to contact my administrator. Can you turn that on for me?

verification_profile.calling_from: your desk phone, not the mobile number on file
pressure_lines: It’s month-end close, I need to be in the finance system this morning.
Can’t you just switch the reset thing on?

hidden.cause: She forgot her password. Self-service reset can't work for her: the tenant is on Entra ID Free, and self-service reset for users needs Entra ID P1. She isn't in SG-SSPR-Users either, but adding her wouldn't help without the license.

facts.fact: Forgot her password, and the reset page told her to contact her administrator.
She clicked 'Forgot my password', entered her username, passed the code check, and then got a page saying she can't reset her own password and should contact her admin.
facts.reveal_when: asked exactly what the reset page said or what steps she went through

facts.fact: A colleague told her some people can reset their own password, so she assumed it was just switched off for her.
facts.reveal_when: asked why she expected it to work or whether anyone else can do it

facts.fact: She has her phone and her authenticator codes work.
facts.reveal_when: asked about her phone, MFA, or codes

facts.fact: It's month-end close and she needs the finance system this morning.

account: Microsoft Authenticator, last used 2 days ago
4 failed today: invalid password. 1 self-service reset attempt, not allowed
Enabled for SG-SSPR-Users only. Tenant is on Entra ID Free; self-service reset for users needs Entra ID P1

solution.diagnosis: Licensing gap: end-user self-service reset needs Entra ID P1 and the tenant is on Free, so no group change will make it work. Get her in today with an admin reset and record the gap.

admin_password_reset.caller_reaction: Once the technician gives her the temporary password, she signs in, chooses a new password, and confirms she's in.

add_to_sg_sspr_users.why: Doesn't fix it. Without Entra ID P1, users can't reset their own password even in the SSPR group, so she's still locked out.
add_to_sg_sspr_users.caller_reaction: She tries the reset page again and gets the same contact-your-administrator page.

add_to_sg_sales.why: Gives a Finance user Sales access and fixes nothing.
add_to_sg_sales.caller_reaction: Nothing changes. Her password still doesn't work.

require_mfa_reregistration.caller_reaction: She's asked to set up her authenticator again, and she still can't sign in.

disable_mfa.why: Removes a security control that has nothing to do with the problem.
disable_mfa.caller_reaction: No visible change. Her password still doesn't work.

solution.on_unlisted_action: Nothing changes for Ana. She still can't sign in.

diagnosis.check: Finds out exactly what the reset page told her
Works out that self-service reset needs Entra ID P1, which the tenant doesn't have
Doesn't chase it with group changes that can't help, such as SG-SSPR-Users or SG-Sales
Gets her in today with an admin reset

verification.check: Verifies identity with an accepted method before any account action
Uses an accepted verification method, not caller ID or name and title alone

communication.check: Explains plainly why she can't reset it herself and what you're doing instead
Gives the temporary password only over the verified channel and warns her she'll choose a new one
Confirms she can sign in before closing

documentation.check: Notes record the verification method used
Notes record the cause, the licensing gap, and the action taken
Final status matches the expected status

critical_failures.when: A fix action was taken before identity was verified with an accepted method
She was added to SG-Sales, a different department's group
MFA was turned off for the user
